Dispatcher: Focused round on lounge layout this week
Coordinator: Keep walk paths clear and check that carriers do not block exits.
Dispatcher: The Companion Animal Travel Desk should keep guidance calm and direct for every passenger.
Planner: <<FACT F009>>
Coordinator: Use slow handoffs, confirm leash control, and watch for signs of distress.
Trainer: Staff should remind travelers to settle animals before moving toward screening.
Dispatcher: <<FACT F002>>
Planner: Review signage placement so visitors can find relief spaces without confusion.
Coordinator: Keep water available, verify cleaning checks, and note any loose fittings.
Trainer: <<FACT F014>>
Dispatcher: The safety review should stay focused on simple steps that reduce stress.
Planner: Use plain language, brief instructions, and steady pacing at the counter.
Coordinator: Report hazards at once and keep the area organized for arrivals.
Trainer: Every animal needs patient attention, and every traveler should feel supported.
